I will keep winter wheat on all my land through spring and early summer, then after harvest I will plant summer maize right away on the same fields. I would rather stay with grain than switch to a crop that needs more market judgment or more delicate management, because I want steady yield, steady sales, and work I can handle confidently. I will use improved or hybrid seed, put on enough fertilizer to protect yield but not push too hard, irrigate when the crop most needs it, spray only as needed for the common diseases, insects, and weeds, and keep field work simple with rotary tillage for wheat and no-tillage planting for maize after wheat harvest.
